channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DeMarre Carroll | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DeMarre Carroll from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:DeMar DeRozan on DeMarre Carroll's attitude after not getting any playing time through the first 3 games:

“DeMarre is the ultimate vet. Always positivity, always working hard. Whenever his name is called, I have no doubt he will be ready.”

DeMar DeRozan on DeMarre Carroll, Oct 31, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
At first Atkinson was reluctant to start Carroll.

“One of the reasons I was hesitant to do it was DeMarre was in a good place coming off the bench. You think of the team first obviously, then you think of the individual, so you’re constantly balancing that,”

Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll, Mar 25, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson:

“DeMarre's still getting back to the DeMarre of last year. I don't think hes there. It's just evolution of him coming back from that injury. We gave him minutes in doses, but I don't think he's in peak form right now.”

Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll, Nov 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on @DeMarre Carroll's return:

“I don’t think it’s big minutes. It’s a gradual buildup like we’ve done w/ every guy that’s come back from injury. We’ll see how he looks in the 1st half & go from there. It’s going to be a feel thing.”

Kenny Atkinson on DeMarre Carroll, Nov 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on DeMarre Carroll, Reggie Jackson
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy:

“I just think a lot of those contracts after this coming summer are gonna look a lot different, whether it's Reggie Jackson or DeMarre Carroll, or whoever. Those contracts are gonna look a bit better after this summer, because this is gonna be crazy.”

Stan Van Gundy on DeMarre Carroll, Reggie Jackson, May 13, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
“There is a way we like to play. We give guys opportunities to make plays and make reads in certain situations. DeMarre grew in that way and the current guys we have will.”

Mike Budenholzer on DeMarre Carroll, Oct 20, 2015. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Jeff Teague on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
“He made me a better player. I think he enjoyed being around all the guys, him and (fellow unrestricted free agent) DeMarre (Carroll). I’m looking forward for them to be back and take another crack at it.”

Jeff Teague on DeMarre Carroll, May 27, 2015. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on DeMarre Carroll
item.description:
Hawks coach Mike Budenholzer said.

“That's how we feel about each of our teammates, each of our players. I know there's that same feeling for DeMarre, and it's the playoffs. So everybody would like him to come through this as healthy as possible.”

Mike Budenholzer on DeMarre Carroll, May 21, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.
